claim.normalised_claim: Ethereum's shift to proof-of-stake resulted in a 99% reduction in its energy consumption.

elements.description: The energy consumption of the Ethereum network before the proof-of-stake transition can be measured.
The energy consumption of the Ethereum network after the proof-of-stake transition can be measured.
The transition to proof-of-stake was the primary cause of the change in energy consumption.
The measured reduction in energy consumption is approximately 99%.
